name: Chair Fragment
description: A broken piece of an old chair. Some have nails sticking out, so be careful.

name: Lesson Notes
description: Notes taken during Youen-sensei's lesson. There are drool marks here and there...

name: Dice
description: Somewhat suspicious dice. Rumour says certain numbers come up rather often...

name: Business Idea Notebook
description: A notebook crammed with plans for secret ventures. All of it thoroughly disreputable.

name: Bomb
description: A modern bomb: small, but boasting real destructive power.

name: Training Certificate
description: Proof that you completed Stephano's training. Without it you might be made to take the training again...?

name: Photo of the Old School Building
description: A photo of the whole old school building. The picture quality is not good.

name: Bloody Ducky's Tooth
description: A Bloody Ducky's tooth. It does not look like it brushes much...

name: Landmine Fragment
description: A fragment of an exploded landmine. It had buried itself in a hard wall and was battered to pieces.

name: Riddle
description: A riddle the mysterious girl left behind. This truly is a riddle.

name: Landmine Wreckage
description: What was left after a landmine exploded. Traces of gunpowder remain.

name: Photo of the Riot
description: A photo somebody took while the students were rioting. It came out so well that the ringleader may have taken it.

name: Barricade
description: A barricade used to stop the enemy breaking through.

name: Final Orb
description: Peer into the part that looks like a pupil and you can supposedly see the word "Final" in very small letters. Whether you believe it is up to you.

name: Final Notebook
description: A legendary book written about all manner of "finals". They say that whenever somebody brings something to an end, it is written in here automatically.

name: Fox Barley
description: An extremely rare variety of barley, a fibre-rich health food, growing wild only in the fox cave. It shines a golden colour.

name: Scoop
description: The latest information, the sort that makes a newspaper worth reading. Print a false story and you lose both trust and standing, so check it carefully.

name: Helian Doll
description: A small stuffed toy modelled on a Woodherian... or so it is claimed. An eerie doll. Something about it feels dangerous.

name: Antique Timer
description: A fragment of an antique that looks like a large cog. Rumour says it can manipulate time.

name: Light Box
description: A light box about the size of a milk crate. Something inside rattles around.

name: Heavy Box
description: A box that is very heavy for its size. A ticking sound comes from inside...

name: Snack
description: A sweeeet snack, made with plenty of chocolate and sugar. Perfect when you want a break, but very high in calories, so eat it prepared to put on weight.

name: Green Peas
description: A rare variety of pea with black markings. It helps with fatigue, so you wake up feeling refreshed.

name: Exchange Coupon
description: A coupon for a uniform set: the Rock Club for Estiva students, the Folk Band Club for Sowol students. Go and talk to Anna!

name: Exchange Coupon
description: A coupon for a uniform set: the Robotics Club for Estiva students, the Archaeology Club for Sowol students. Go and talk to Anna!

name: World Map
description: A map of the whole world. Because of the scale, it is no help at all when you are lost.

name: Healing Research Notes
description: A book recording know-how useful for treating not only people but all sorts of animals and monsters.

name: Easter Egg
description: An egg that has been painted or drawn on. Used at Easter.

name: Trace of a Legend
description: A trace said to appear nearby whenever a legend is born. Historians build their research on traces like this.

name: Teardrop Shard
description: A gem said to form when a fallen tear crystallises. It is teardrop-shaped: round below, conical above.

name: Marionette
description: A mechanical doll made abroad. Not that different from a puppet.

name: Sucheong's Diary
description: The diary in which Sucheong writes up the day's events. Surprisingly meticulous, though every word has been doctored in his favour.

name: Page from Torvalds' Diary
description: A page from the diary of L. Torvalds, chairman of the shopping-district alliance, recording his daily life. It has come apart, so it cannot be read.

name: Lunchbox
description: A very appetising lunchbox. It is a real shame that it has to be delivered to Shitoumaru.

name: Grilled Mutton
description: Very appetising grilled mutton. It has to be delivered to Shitoumaru, but surely one bite...?

name: Report Card
description: Arena's report card. Deliver it without looking inside.

name: Rock CD
description: A CD by a minor rock band you have probably never heard of. Calling it a "disc" is questionable, and the songs on it are about as individual in style. Deliver it to Arena.

name: Mystery Feed
description: No telling what is in it, but it smells appalling. What animal is this feed for? Deliver it to Hachi.

name: Sparkling Stone
description: A sparkling stone that looks useful for making accessories. Deliver it to Hachi.

name: Exercise Book
description: An exercise book for studying at home. Deliver it to Father Vermont.

name: Rosary Bead
description: A glossy rosary bead. Deliver it to Father Vermont.

name: Mutant Soso Fragment
description: A shred of a mutant Soso, torn up so badly that nothing of its original shape is left.

name: Soso Blueprint
description: A blueprint explaining how to make a Soso. Apparently making one is very easy.

name: Ben-sensei's Secret Savings
description: An envelope with Ben-sensei's secret savings in it. So thin it makes you sad...

name: 4th-Dimension Classroom Report
description: Grey's report on his investigation of the 4D Classroom. Written in great detail, including things that look unimportant at first glance.

name: Manga
description: A collected volume of manga. It is a popular one, but the pages are folded and torn and the whole thing is falling apart.

name: Student Council Papers
description: Papers drawn up by the Sowol Academy student council. So thick that nobody could face reading them.

name: Small Antique Fragment
description: A small fragment of an antique, shaped like a cog. What it is for is unclear.

name: Student Council Papers
description: Papers drawn up by the Estiva Academy student council. Quite thick.

name: Soso Fragment
description: A shred of a Soso, torn up so badly that nothing of its original shape is left.

name: Precious Photo
description: The precious photo China lost. But all that is in it is odd machinery...?

name: Page from a Rare Book
description: A page that fell out of a valuable book. Collect them all and it might be possible to restore it...

name: Gunpowder
description: A bottle packed with purple gunpowder. Extremely dangerous! Keep away from flame!

name: Lamb's Wool
description: A bundle of soft, fluffy lamb's wool. It looks very warm.

name: Barausu Leaf
description: A Barausu's leaf. It smells terrible, but apparently it makes medicine.

name: Pumpkin
description: A pumpkin with an odd pattern carved into it. It still looks edible.

name: Globee's Insides
description: Meat taken from inside a Globee's hard shell. It hardly looks edible.

name: Soso Skeleton's Bone
description: A bone that came out of a Soso Skeleton. Is this really a Soso Skeleton's skeleton?

name: Stone Slab Fragment
description: A fragment of a large stone slab that split apart.

name: Kamaitachi's Medicine
description: The medicine a kamaitachi keeps hidden. It is said to be the specific remedy for a kamaitachi's cuts.

name: Ghost Girl's Hair
description: A ghost's hair, as though a grudge were bound up in it. Just looking at it sends a chill down your spine.

name: Ghost Boy's Undershirt
description: A scrap of a ghost's undershirt, as though regret were bound up in it. Rotted right through.

name: Rosie's Fang
description: A tooth from Hachi's pet. They come in all sizes, from small to large.

name: Prisoner's Handcuffs
description: The handcuffs that were on a Prisoner's wrists.

name: Parcel
description: A parcel that went missing in a delivery mishap.

name: Inject's Medicine
description: Inject's important medicine. What it treats is unclear...

name: Page from the Nursing Log
description: A torn page that fell out of the nursing log. Even with all of them, restoring it may not be possible...

name: Black Candyfloss
description: Black, fluffy candyfloss (?). The taste is beyond imagining.

name: Dimension Fish's Float Tissue
description: The float tissue of a dimension fish. It hardly seems enough to fly with...?

name: Chair Fighter Fragment
description: A fragment of a Chair Fighter. It gives off a strange air.

name: Luminous Substance
description: A mysterious substance giving off a glow so faint you only notice it in the dark. Gather enough and it will light a book at night.

name: How to Raise a Cockoo
description: A book handed down among the mysterious Linti tribe, describing their secret method of raising Cockoos.

name: Mysterious Flower
description: A special flower said to grow as a parasite on the bodies of the mysterious Linti. It smells extremely odd.

name: Fruit of Conversation
description: A mysterious fruit known for letting you talk with Woodherians when eaten.

name: 100x Sweetness Special Candy
description: A candy made by a special method known only to the mysterious Linti tribe. It is said to be 100 times sweeter than ordinary sweets.
